_README: Label id -> structure for the Visible Human MALE right forearm muscle volume (vhm_forearm_muscles_from_cryo.py). A KEY, not data. rule-based: see the script docstring for the rule; compartments are muscles the photographs do not separate (mapped to null).
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male cryosections at full resolution (0.33 mm) and frozen CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhm_forearm_muscles_from_cryo.py), rule-based.
